verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference that covers workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions. Explicit 'everything the UI does' parity is claimed only for jitsu-cli, not for the API itself. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common machine-readable paths, though that does not contradict the documented reference at docs.jitsu.com/api. Missing for 10: an explicit API-level UI-parity statement, documented API coverage of Live Events, profiles, audit log and user/token management, a machine-discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: A public Management API for every Jitsu instance, with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api.
Jitsu exposes an HTTP API for managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions.
jitsu-cli — a real command-line interface that does everything the UI does.
